Package it.polimi.ingsw.exceptions

package it.polimi.ingsw.exceptions
  • Exception Classes
    Class
    Description
    GameException
    General-purpose exception thrown when an unexpected error occurs during the game.
    InvalidCardException
    Exception thrown when an invalid or unrecognized card is used during the game.
    InvalidDrawException
    Exception thrown when an invalid or unrecognized draw action is used during the game.
    InvalidLobbyException
    Exception thrown when an invalid or unrecognized lobby is selected.
    InvalidLobbySizeException
    Exception thrown when an invalid lobby size is specified during lobby creation.
    InvalidMoveException
    Exception thrown when an invalid or unrecognized tile is selected to move into.
    InvalidPhaseException
    Exception thrown when an action is performed during an invalid game phase.
    InvalidPlayerException
    Exception thrown when a player tries to do an action not during his turn.
    InvalidSkipException
    Exception thrown when an invalid skip is requested during the game.
    InvalidTimingException
    Exception thrown when a command is issued outside its valid context: either a lobby command is issued while a match is already in progress, or a game command is issued before joining a match.
    InvalidUsernameException
    Exception thrown when a player tries to register an invalid username: either already in use or blank/null.
    OccupiedTileException
    Exception thrown when an already occupied tile is selected to move into.
